opening.argument: The presentation describes launching a Forsage campaign by automatically separating a 400 TRON payment into its programs, while campaign slots can receive “an endless number of contributions.” It then portrays slot unlocking as a path from a few dollars worth of TRON to hundreds, thousands, and eventually tens of thousands, repeatedly. The recruitment flow is equally explicit: sharing Forsage enables another person to launch a campaign, and that later campaign benefits the first through a contribution. The arrangement is therefore presented as a crowdfunding opportunity in which participation and tiered unlocking can bring increasingly substantial TRON and improve one’s financial future. Although one funding-chart segment is limited to illustrative purposes and disclaims guarantees, that qualification does not remove the separately narrated payment, contribution, escalation, and financial-future claims.

citations.quote: When you launch your campaign on Forsage, the smart contract automatically separates your 400tron into each of the programs respectfully.
as you work through this unlocking process, you progress from receiving a few dollars worth of TRON to hundreds, thousands and eventually tens of thousands of dollars worth of TRON again and again.
In return for sharing the platform, a supporter with the second campaign, benefits the first by way of a contribution.
you will be actively acquiring tremendous amounts of TRON that will significantly alter the trajectory of your financial future
The following is for illustrated purposes only. No claims, promises, or guarantees of funding are being made
